title: Manually Open/Close Tipper Grippers Using VISU_MANCONTROL
summary: On the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen VISU_MANCONTROL, use the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button for the corresponding tipper (LEFT or RIGHT) to manually command the gripper to open or close, then verify the physical gripper state changes accordingly.
when_to_use: Use when you need to manually actuate a specific tipper gripper (LEFT or RIGHT) via the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen VISU_MANCONTROL.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the manual gripper open/close command from VISU_MANCONTROL and verify physical gripper movement; escalate if the gripper does not respond.
safety_notes: If there is imminent danger to personnel or risk of equipment damage, use the appropriate safety response (the manual includes an emergency stop push-button on the operator station push-button panel).
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Operator Station HMI) access to the VISU_MANCONTROL screen
Physical access/visual confirmation of the corresponding tipper gripper state

visual_references.description: VISU_MANCONTROL screen showing the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button(s) for the corresponding tipper and related manual controls.

steps.title: Open the VISU_MANCONTROL manual control screen
steps.purpose: Access the HMI screen that contains the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE manual gripper controls.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, navigate to the maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.
steps.expected_result: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen is displayed with the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button for the corresponding tipper.
steps.healthy_condition: The VISU_MANCONTROL screen is visible and the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE control(s) are present for manual gripper actuation.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access VISU_MANCONTROL or the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE controls are not available on the displayed screen.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_MANCONTROL
actions.exact_action: Open the Operator Station HMI maintenance manual control screen named VISU_MANCONTROL.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen Item 4: The GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button will manually open or close the gripper of the corresponding tipper.

source_evidence.summary: VISU_MANCONTROL includes GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button to manually open/close the gripper of the corresponding tipper.

steps.title: Command the LEFT or RIGHT tipper gripper to open or close
steps.purpose: Send the manual open/close command to the selected tipper gripper.
steps.instruction: On VISU_MANCONTROL, select the corresponding tipper side (LEFT or RIGHT) and press the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button to command the gripper to open or close.
steps.expected_result: A manual open/close command is issued for the selected tipper gripper via the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button.
steps.healthy_condition: You have selected the correct tipper side (LEFT or RIGHT) and pressed the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button for that side.
steps.failure_condition: You press the control for the wrong side, or the command cannot be issued from the screen.

actions.label: Press GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE for selected tipper
actions.exact_action: Select the corresponding tipper side (LEFT or RIGHT) and press the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button to command the gripper to open or close.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen Item 4: The GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button will manually open or close the gripper of the corresponding tipper.

steps.title: Verify physical gripper state matches the command
steps.purpose: Confirm the manual command resulted in the expected physical gripper movement.
steps.instruction: Physically observe the corresponding tipper and confirm the gripper changes state to match the command (open vs closed).
steps.expected_result: The corresponding tipper gripper opens or closes in response to the GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button command.
steps.healthy_condition: The physical gripper position changes to the commanded state (open when commanded open; closed when commanded close).
steps.failure_condition: The physical gripper does not move to the commanded open/closed state.

actions.label: Visually confirm gripper position
actions.exact_action: Verify the corresponding tipper gripper changes state to match the command (open vs closed) using physical observation at the tipper.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the gripper does not move to the commanded open/closed state.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen Item 4: The GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button will manually open or close the gripper of the corresponding tipper.

source_evidence.summary: VISU_MANCONTROL includes GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button to manually open/close the gripper of the corresponding tipper.

steps.title: Escalate if the gripper does not respond
steps.purpose: Ensure unresolved manual actuation is handled through escalation.
steps.instruction: If the gripper does not move to the commanded open/closed state, stop the attempt and escalate.
steps.expected_result: Escalation is initiated due to lack of physical response to the open/close command.
steps.healthy_condition: Not applicable (this step triggers only on failure).
steps.failure_condition: Continuing without escalation despite no physical response.

actions.label: Stop and escalate
actions.exact_action: Stop and escalate if the gripper does not move to the commanded open/closed state.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-23: Operator Station HMI Manual Control Screen Item 4: The GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE button will manually open or close the gripper of the corresponding tipper.

success_criteria: After pressing GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE for the selected tipper side, the corresponding tipper gripper physically opens or closes to match the command.
healthy_conditions: Physical gripper state changes to open when commanded open, and to closed when commanded closed.
failure_conditions: Physical gripper does not move to the commanded open/closed state after pressing GRIPPERS OPEN/CLOSE.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the gripper does not respond to the open/close command.
